ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels across central lobes and 20% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle, median notch, and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the primary surface of both lobes; a dark triangular peduncle-base extends into a narrow black median notch; a continuous black band follows the trailing edge; scattered black punctate spots are visible on the upper-right and lower-left ventral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 65-70 degree interior angle; depth corresponds to roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height in the 2D plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-7 pixel variance) along the posterior margin; topography becomes significantly more irregular and jagged at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Yellow-brown high-contrast pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating localized barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-left ventral lobe; additional diagonal linear marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips of both lobes; prominent dark rake marks on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric distribution of mottle; the right lobe exhibits a higher density of small dark focal spots compared to the left lobe.
